ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Standard"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Pull")), OR(AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Queue"), ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "User")), ISBLANK(Source_Id__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Field Value"), OR(ISBLANK(Source_Field__c), ISBLANK(Source_Ready_Value__c))), ISPICKVAL(Source_Type__c, "Any")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Standard and Pull distributors need a source: a queue or user Id, or a field and ready value.
